health-who-minimum.label: WHO 2020 weekly aerobic target for adults
health-who-minimum.value: 150–300 min moderate or 75–150 min vigorous activity, or an equal mix

health-kodama-met.label: Risk ratio for all-cause death per 1-MET higher fitness

health-steps-plateau.label: Daily steps where the mortality curve flattens

health-met-definition.label: MET definition and intensity bands
health-met-definition.value: 1 MET ≈ 3.5 mL·kg⁻¹·min⁻¹ of oxygen at rest; moderate 3 to under 6 METs, vigorous 6 METs or more
